subject: MerchantCo remediation closure: corrective actions, exec summary and next steps
messages:
From: Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@merchantco.com>
To: ava.chen@redwood.ai
Cc: Sophie Palmer <sophie.palmer@merchantco.com>, support@merchantco.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 20:12:00 -0500
Subject: Major latency/error spikes this afternoon — urgent

Hi Ava,

We saw repeated 95th/99th percentile latency spikes and a burst of 5xx errors starting ~14:10 UTC today that impacted checkout flows for ~45 minutes. Attached are our telemetry snapshots and a short video of the user experience. We previously raised a support ticket (OPS-4123) but the impact escalated quickly.

Immediate asks:
- Can you confirm whether this is a model-serving regression or infra (GPU) throttling?
- Are there any mitigations we can toggle from our end?
- We need an executive readout for our CTO tomorrow morning.

This is high stakeholder visibility on our side — please escalate.

Thanks,
Alex
Director of Platform Engineering
MerchantCo

Attachments: merchantco_incident_graphs.zip (zip, 1.2MB)
From: ava.chen@redwood.ai <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@merchantco.com>, MerchantCo Support <support@merchantco.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 20:28:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Major latency/error spikes this afternoon — urgent

Alex, Sophie — thanks for the quick heads up and the attachments.

Short update / immediate mitigation:
- We routed MerchantCo traffic to the warm fallback cluster (lower-capacity model variant) at 14:35 UTC to reduce error rate while we triaged. That reduced 5xx by ~80% within 5 minutes.
- We throttled long conversational requests and lowered per-request token ceilings (temporary) to reduce KV cache pressure.

Next steps (we will deliver a formal RCA and remediation plan by COB tomorrow):
- Internal postmortem to identify root cause (model runtime kernel selection vs caching behavior). Jordan and Kim are leading the triage.
- We will produce a one-page executive summary for your CTO.
- Proposing a short call at 09:00 ET tomorrow for an exec readout — does that work?

Jordan, Kim — assigning initial tasks: please collect runtime logs (kernel selection traces, GPU metrics) and correlate with MerchantCo request IDs (see attached zip). David, please pull node-level telemetry for the pool that served MerchantCo at 14:00–15:00 UTC.

Thanks — we know this is visible and will prioritize.

Regards,
Ava Chen
Account Lead, Priority Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: ava.chen@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai, david.kim@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@merchantco.com>, Sophie Palmer <sophie.palmer@merchantco.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -05:00
Subject: RCA draft and remediation matrix for MerchantCo (v1)

Team / Alex, Sophie — attaching the first-pass RCA (merchantco_rca_v1.pdf) and a remediation task CSV. Summary highlights below.

Executive summary (TL;DR):
- Root cause: under certain load patterns with a long-tail token distribution, the runtime selected a suboptimal kernel path that increased token processing time and triggered excessive KV cache churn. The kernel selector misclassified ~12% of requests between 14:05–14:30 UTC.
- Symptom cascade: kernel slowness -> KV cache eviction spikes -> longer per-request latencies -> queued requests exceeded per-worker limits -> transient 5xx errors.
- Impact window: 14:10–14:55 UTC. Estimated affected requests: ~23k (peak RPS 3x baseline).

Corrective actions (owner — ETA):
- Fix kernel selection threshold logic and deploy hotfix to canary (Jordan) — ETA 2026-11-13 11:00 ET.
- Add golden traffic test for long-tail token sequences in CI (Kimberly) — ETA 2026-11-20.
- Increase KV cache reservation for priority customers by default; add config flag (David) — ETA 2026-11-18.
- Run retrospective with MerchantCo and execs; provide credits for impacted consumption (Ava) — proposal by 2026-11-14.

Attachments referenced: merchantco_rca_v1.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB), remediation_tasks.csv (CSV, 6KB).

Alex — can you confirm value of a configuration flag to opt-in to higher KV reservations vs us making it default for MerchantCo? Also, please confirm if you want the exec readout at 09:00 ET tomorrow; if not, we can move to 10:30.

From: ava.chen@redwood.ai <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@merchantco.com>, Sophie Palmer <sophie.palmer@merchantco.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 17:45:00 -05:00
Subject: Closure: MerchantCo remediation, actions completed and follow-through cadence

Alex / Sophie — thank you for the time on the call this morning. This message closes the incident with a short record of what we completed and how we’ll follow through.

What we shipped:
- 11/13 11:05 ET — kernel selector fix deployed to canary and validated against the golden long-tail traffic suite; no regressions observed.
- 11/13 14:40 ET — kernel fix promoted to main serving pool for MerchantCo traffic; observed 95th latency drop from ~1.8s to ~0.45s across the affected routes.
- 11/13 15:10 ET — KV cache reservation flag enabled for MerchantCo; cache eviction events dropped by 92%.
- Credit proposal: offering a one-time consumption credit equal to 20% of impacted token spend (proposal sent to procurement).

Open follow-up items (owner — due):
- Harden CI with long-tail token golden test / Kimberly Park — due 2026-11-20.
- Backfill detailed per-request kernel selection traces for legal/audit — Jordan Blake — due 2026-11-17.
- Update runbook and add a short playbook for priority customers that includes automatic fallback routing thresholds — David Kim — due 2026-11-24.
- Exec readout deck finalized and shared — Ava Chen — due 2026-11-14 (uploaded to drive).

Links and artifacts:
- RCA v1 (pdf): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcDeF-merchantco-rca
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4123
- Remediation tasks CSV (internal): https://drive.google.com/open?id=remediation_tasks_csv

Final note: We’ll run a two-week post-change observation window and provide a short weekly digest. If MerchantCo wants a dedicated runbook change (make higher KV reservation default for the account), we can convert the config flag into a policy and schedule in next sprint; please confirm decision by 2026-11-20.

Thanks again for the partnership — we’ll keep monitoring closely.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Lead, Priority Accounts
Redwood Inference
